title: Fukanzazengi Part 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk explores the concept of reality and understanding, drawing on the teachings of Dogen, a Japanese priest who wrote "Fukanzazengi", a text on Zen practice that challenges traditional notions of enlightenment as something to be achieved through meditation or effort. Instead, Dogen's text suggests that reality is already perfect and all-pervading, and that true understanding comes from recognizing what is already present, rather than trying to fix or change it. This approach encourages a sense of immediacy and non-separation, inviting readers to explore the depths of their own experience without attachment to concepts like separation and lack.
